parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the task. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter parameter.

> For the supported filter parameters and values, see **Request parameters description**.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter parameter.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The node ID.
>This parameter is applicable only to cluster instances. You can specify this parameter to query the batch task of a specific node. If you do not specify this parameter, the batch task of the primary node is returned by default.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description:
The node information of the PolarDB-X 2.0 database instance.

- **polarx_cn**: compute node.

- **polarx_dn**: data node.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the task. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The task type.

- **Export**: export task.
> For the filter parameters and values supported by **Export**, see **Request parameters description**.
- **Query**: query task.
